items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I figured this other boy, Rose Gellie Charles, was more familiar with it... [INTERVIEWEE] What were y'all doing? Were you swinging hammers or axes?

ctx.x: hammering. Well I wasn't too familiar with this song. I figured this other boy, Rose Gellie Charles, was more familiar with it. Riding the Mason, which we call Louisiana. They was participating in it and he sang it. He was the vocalist on this song.
What were y'all doing? Were you swinging hammers or axes?
